notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Walk the Aeons and Flicker of Fate.
description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons and Flicker of Fate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
